description: Juno PM — agent graph realigned to the finalized AWSpec (05-agentic-workflows/awspec.md) and Agent Control Panel (05-agentic-workflows/agent-control-panel.md). ReAct pattern, single agent, cited priority output, PM approval gate before anything publishes. Import into Langflow if you want to run it live, provider-agnostic, add your own LLM API key as a Langflow environment variable, never hardcoded here.
name: Juno PM — P0 Triage Agent

data.label: New #escalations thread, P0/P1
data.description: Trigger: new transcript added to the Raw Input column, tagged P0 or P1. In production this is fed by a webhook on #escalations, no manual start.

data.label: Juno North Star
corpus.retrieve
data.description: RAG retrieval over the RocketShip Strategy One-Pager (02-strategy/strategy-one-pager.md), including the four named strategic pillars.

data.label: jira.read_ticket
data.description: Cross-check the linked Jira ROCKET ticket's priority against the Slack escalation's tag. Read-only, surfaces conflicts, never resolves them (PRD requirement 5).

data.label: Reasoning model (provider-agnostic)
data.description: Compares the pain point to the four strategic pillars and scores risk + alignment. Provider and API key are runtime config in Langflow, not stored here.
data._note: Add your own LLM provider's API key as a Langflow environment variable. Never commit a key to this file.

data.label: Flag conflicting signal
data.description: Card is tagged 'conflicting signal' with both citations shown side by side. Forces PM review regardless of confidence (Control Panel Checkpoints).

data.label: Insufficient evidence banner
data.description: Confidence < 30%, or fewer than 3 retrieved segments, or no strategy doc loaded. No priority assigned. 'Insufficient evidence to recommend priority, load a strategy document or escalate to PM judgement.'

data.label: juno.draft_card
data.description: Writes a draft Insight Card: priority, confidence, citations, status. Always draft, never published directly.

data.label: juno.draft_prd_section
data.description: Writes a draft PRD section (Problem / Goal / Scope / Out of Scope / Open Questions). Always draft, never published directly.

data.label: PM approval gate
data.description: No card, priority, or PRD section is published, shared, or exported until a PM clicks Approve. This is the Copilot autonomy boundary, enforced here, not just stated as policy (PRD requirement 6).

_readme.purpose: Realigned Langflow export for the optional M5 post-class lab, matching the finalized AWSpec and Agent Control Panel exactly (top-K=6, three-way confidence routing, Jira/Slack conflict check, PM approval gate, no hardcoded LLM provider).
tools_required: an LLM provider API key of your choice (~$5 credit is enough for the lab), added as a Langflow environment variable, never in this file
what_changed_from_v0.1.0: Removed the hardcoded OpenAI node, replaced with a provider-agnostic 'Reasoning model' node. Provider/key are runtime config, not stored here.
Removed the two Slack-post output nodes, Juno's write boundary is its own draft store only, it cannot post to Slack (agent-control-panel.md Permissions).
Added the Jira cross-check and conflict-flagging branch (PRD requirement 5), previously described in docs but never represented in the graph.
Confidence guardrail is now three-way (>=70 high, 30-69 medium, <30 insufficient-evidence), not a single 70% cutoff.
Added an explicit, blocking PM approval gate node before anything is treated as final (PRD requirement 6).
_readme.known_limitation: This graph has not been run inside actual Langflow, it was authored to match the AWSpec exactly and is ready to import, but hasn't been execution-tested against a live LLM. See 05-agentic-workflows/dry-run/ for a real execution of this same logic, done without Langflow.
